$comment: An expense or a settlement in a group. Amounts are integer cents, so sums are exact. members is a copy of the group's members when the expense was written: rules can't read the group, so they check this copy instead (see the docs page on this example for why that's a hole).

kind.description: settlement: paid_by paid the one person in split_between back.

amount.description: In cents of the group's currency.
